Paycheck photo cuts text at the right edge of the screen mid-word: the subtitle ends 'Paid monthly? Ski' and the note ends 'Type your real take-home '.

Laptop photos shrink the tab and leave wide white margins inside the screen (the page fills about 60-70% of the screen width). Start here's step text is about 12px at 2700px, so the useful part is not shown large (r013).

Month tabs: log row 11 is taller than the rest because it shares a row with the summary header. Nothing on the tab says what to do after the 80th entry.

Links render as LibreOffice's #000080 in the shots and photos, not the evergreen set in the file. Photo captions 'BILL TRACKER' and 'PAYCHECK' are not the tab names (Bills, Paycheck plan).
The how-it-works photo has an empty top third. The hero shows a thin empty box edge (the top of the bar chart) at the bottom of the screen.

notes: Google Sheets import not tested here. Sheet protection does not carry over (the file says so). Excel charts are restyled by Sheets. The month dropdowns use a list from the named range 'Categories', and the Paycheck formulas use a defined name 'Year', which matches the YEAR() function name. Confirm both survive import before launch.

Day one, Oct 22 2026: step 1 to 3 work. Step 4 now tells an October buyer to set Year to 2026 and use Oct to Dec. Paycheck then defaults to the first Friday of 2026, and the buyer types their next payday to get Oct 23 to Dec 18. Savings uses TODAY() correctly. A buyer can reach a usable October tab.

Day one, May 2027: Year 2027 is already right. The jump grid reaches May, empty months stay out of the Dashboard, and Paycheck lists the whole of 2027 until the buyer types their next payday. The sample Savings dates (Jul/Sep/Dec 2027) still work. A buyer can reach a usable May tab.

Round-1 findings verified fixed: Paycheck 27-row cap, Debt 'Extra each month' unused, Excel-only data bars, external-style '#Sheet' links, shaded summary labels, Bills nav cut, clipped wrapped headers, Ready check false 'Example cleared', Savings #NUM!, missing browser-preview advice, October not covered, bar-axis cents, frozen headers on Dashboard/Debt/Savings, Help-line service promise, photo alt text claiming off-frame content. Not fixed: chart font (Calibri), Start here no freeze, row-11 height, Start nav gap, inside-grid readability.
